name: Homebox
description: Self-hosted home inventory and organization system for tracking items, locations, and warranties.

no_official_figure.note: No stated minimum or recommended RAM/CPU requirement exists in official Homebox sources (README, docs site quick-start). The README's project-principles section offers only an observed idle-usage anecdote, not a requirement: "In general, idle memory usage is less than 50MB for the whole container." This is an OBSERVED idle figure for a single-user/empty-inventory instance, not a stated minimum or recommended requirement (Defect Class #2), so it is preserved here as descriptive context only, not filed as ram_min_mb/ram_rec_mb.

deps.note: Homebox uses an embedded SQLite database and embedded web UI; the official docker-compose.yml and README both run a single homebox container with no external database or cache service.
